messages:
alex: Heads-up - embeddings service is returning garbled vectors for recent requests (customer reports, error rate spike).
luna_oncall: seeing it in SLO graphs, +400% error for /embed in eu-west1 over last 3m.
alex: Can we get a hotfix out asap? Root cause looks like a tensor-reshape regression from yesterday's runtime tweak. I have a cherrypick ready: commit d3f4b1a -> release/patch.
sam_release: What roll strategy do you want? Normal canary will take ~40m.
alex: Need expedited path. Propose: pin stable runtime image (v2.14.1), skip canary for 30m window, limited traffic to Dedicated and Hosted tier only, and monitor. Rollback plan: revert to v2.14.0 and drain eu-west1 if any >1% error spike.
nate_prod: Customer impact high, +1 for expedited. Is there a data-safety risk? 
maya_eng: No data exfil, just malformed outputs. Patch is small. I validated locally with the failing prompt set.
ops_lead: We need signoff from oncall + release to skip canary. Also include release notes blurb for the customer-facing team.
luna_oncall: I can sign off to skip canary for 30m as long as we limit concurrency to 50% and have the rollback trigger scripted.
sam_release: Agree. I'll prepare the deploybot command. @deploybot we'll need a pinned deploy: image=redwood/runtime:v2.14.1-pin-patch d3f4b1a, scope=eu-west1, traffic=dedicated,hosted, concurrency-limit=50%, canary=false, monitor-window=30m
deploybot: [ACTION REQUIRED] deploy request queued by sam_release. Details: image=redwood/runtime:v2.14.1-pin-patch commit=d3f4b1a scope=eu-west1 traffic=dedicated,hosted concurrency=50% canary=false monitor=30m. Please confirm with reactions.
alex: :thumbsup: confirmed from eng side.
luna_oncall: :thumbsup: oncall ok. I'll watch metrics and run the failing prompt set after rollout.
sam_release: @ops_lead please confirm release notes & customer comms.
ops_lead: I'll draft a short release note: "hotfix: embeddings tensor reshape regression -> bad vectors; applied runtime patch v2.14.1 (cherry-pick d3f4b1a). Impact: elevated embed errors in eu-west1; fixed."
ops_lead: Sending draft to product for customer comms.
nate_prod: Approved for customer notice. Include mitigation steps and contact.
sam_release: Running deploy now.
deploybot: [DEPLOY STARTED] 1714456820 - sam_release triggered deploy to eu-west1. image=redwood/runtime:v2.14.1-pin-patch commit=d3f4b1a
luna_oncall: seeing pods rollout, starting smoke tests.
maya_eng: smoke OK so far, small sample looks good.
deploybot: [HEALTH CHECK] 1714456845 - monitor: 5m aggregated error rate dropped to baseline.
sam_release: marking rollout as expedited pin; will keep monitor window open for 30m then evaluate full rollout.
alex: thanks all. If anything regresses we revert to v2.14.0 and run fallback traffic to us-west.
luna_oncall: all clear for now. I'll file a follow-up incident summary with telemetry and timeline.
ops_lead: will publish release note & update support playbook.
deploybot: [DEPLOY COMPLETE] 1714456875 - expedited deploy finished; status=success.
